sloka: तत्र राजासनं दिव्यं व्यजनं छत्रमेव च ।भरतो मन्त्रिभि: सार्द्धमभ्यवर्त्तत राजवत् ॥ २.९१.३७॥
transliteration: tatra rājāsanaṁ divyaṁ vyajanaṁ chatrameva ca ।bharato mantribhi: sārddhamabhyavarttata rājavat ॥ 2.91.37॥

translations.english: All the ministers, priests followed him and were glad to see the arrangement in that mansion.
